messages:
Alex P.: kicking off glidepath model enable for glidepath-v1. aiming for low-traffic window tonight (03:00-03:30 UTC). tagging ops and deploybot for handshake.
Maria C.: looks good. telemetry checks? we'll need prefix cache warmup and sample prompt evals.
DeployBot: scheduled enable glidepath-v1 -> model-catalog at 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z window 30m. status: pending approval.
Joel K.: propose fallback ordering: glidepath-v1 -> atlas-slim -> atlas-quant. glidepath wins on short-form latencies but has some long-tail drift, so atlas-slim first fallback.
Pranav S.: +1. also request we pin v1.0.3 for initial 10% traffic for 20m then ramp by 30m increments.
Kate L.: ops checklist: 1) canary route, 2) obs gate (latency p95 < 300ms), 3) no safety regressions on eval set. I'll watch traces.
Alex P.: Maria can you run the eval set and post results before we flip DeployBot? we need token-cost delta and quality delta.
Maria C.: running now. sample command:
```
python infra/evals/run_eval.py --model glidepath-v1 --prompts samples/ops_rost.txt --out /tmp/gp_eval.json
```
(1200 prompts, ETA ~7m)
SRE Bot: note: region us-west-2 capacity headroom at 03:00 UTC is ~18% (nets out to ~8k rps capacity). Watch queue depth.
DeployBot: approval required from @Alex P. and @Kate L. to start. react with :white_check_mark: to approve.
Alex P.: :white_check_mark: approved. Start window aligned.
Kate L.: :white_check_mark: approved. obs on.
DeployBot: enable starting 03:00Z... step 1/4: warm cache (prefix warming) -> completed.
DeployBot: step 2/4: open 10% traffic route -> completed. canary id=cb-6239. Traffic distribution: glidepath-v1 10%, atlas-slim 90%.
Maria C.: quick glance at evals: quality delta +0.6% (ops_metric), cost +8%. uploading summary: https://redwood.app/ops/reports/gp_eval_6239
Joel K.: telemetry: p95 latency +25ms on canary, error rate stable. no safety flags.
Pranav S.: propose fallback reorder if latency > 350ms for 5m -> route to atlas-quant. set TTL 10m. Anyone object?
Alex P.: no objection. set policy.
DeployBot: policy applied: fallback_on_latency_threshold=350ms duration=300s fallback_target=atlas-quant ttl=600s
SRE Bot: monitoring alerts enabled: latency_watch, error_watch, cost_watch. Slack alerts to #eng-sre and #eng-releases.
Kate L.: plan: ramp to 40% at 03:20Z if no alerts, then full at 03:50Z. rollback on any safety eval failure or sustained latency >350ms for 10m.
Alex P.: I'll stay on call for the window. Thanks everyone.
